forecastTime: Row i is lead (i+1)·dt after observed context; no truth resets.
precision: Stored states converted to Float32 for display. Episode events copied unchanged; summary errors computed from original stored forecasts using Float64 arithmetic.
scoreDefinition: Per displayed origin: coordinate RMSE/MAE and full-state RMSE normalized by pooled physical training standard deviations. Early window is first 180 forecast steps; full window is every saved forecast sample. Observed context is excluded.
originSelection: Reference plus first origin of each held-out IC (0,1,3,5,7); no score selection.

policy.joint_rule: Any physical variable fails value, slope or curvature
policy.interpretation: Retrospective onset requires a complete following window. Recovery remains possible.
policy.development_scope: Shared multiplier calibrated on four annotated model cases of one Van der Pol trajectory; autonomous systems have no visual labels.

sensitivity.separationPrecision: Euclidean distances computed in Float64, then exported as Float32 scalars.
sensitivity.solver: Independent SciPy RK45 integrations, rtol=1e-11, atol=1e-13
sensitivity.note: Finite numerical illustration; not an estimate of an asymptotic exponent.

pendulum.method: Predict state increments from sin/cos angles, velocities and (for the wheel) every bucket mass; 2 hidden layers of 128 SiLU units; four-step recursive loss; checkpoint selected on separate 180-step validation forecasts.

failure.reason: Learned state left the numerical display guard; the rollout is not a completed forecast.

displayGuard.rule: Stop before nonfinite state, speed over 10 times maximum training magnitude, or wheel bucket mass below -1e-5. Not a forecast-accuracy threshold.
